role: The /weather command: clear, rain or thunder, with a drawn duration of (300+rand(600))*20 ticks or a given seconds argument times 20.
scope_reason: Commands never run in this game: the product has no chat text entry (no chat handling in csrc/play/play.c) and no harness path constructs ServerCommandManager (grep of oracle/harness finds none); the behaviors the project needs are the Dev ops of oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Dev.java and csrc/engine/dev.c, not this command system.

members.name: processCommand
members.note: the Dev 'weather' op sets rain_time/thunder_time/raining/thundering the same way and draws the default duration on the DET_SERVER stream; the chat lines are absent natively

notes: Line 35 draws its Random from netherite.oracle.Det.newRandom(): a determinize hook edit, the draw the native weather op mirrors. Static __OBFID constants are grouped out per the brief.
